description: North Central Provincial Council - Revised Statute of Road Passenger Transport Authority Act, Amending Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 1997/27 of 16.12.2016
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment and consolidation of provincial statutes and regulations related to road passenger transport, including revised fees, fines, and regulatory requirements for various vehicle types. It constitutes legal/regulatory matter as it deals with statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements for transportation services in the North Central Province.
